newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Crew of twenty-four to abandon ship off Hong Kong.
newsitem.headline: Crew of twenty-four to abandon ship off Hong Kong.

text.p: Lloyds Shipping has reported the 24-person crew of the Equator Pearl plans to abandon ship, following engine breakdown, off Hong Kong.

Singapore Radio who picked up the may-day call at 0337 GMT, informed Llyods the 8,447 DWt (dead weight tonnes) vessel was in a dangerous situation with the ship listing 45 degrees in very rough seas as a typhoon approaches.
Singapore Radio told Reuters it had passed the message to Hong Kong's Rescue Co-ordination Centre to take charge of the search and rescue as the vessel was "very close to Hong Kong."
The vessel was positioned at latitude 20.10.8 north and longitutde 114.08.5 east when it sent out the signal.
The owner of the Vessel, Singapore-based Thong Soon Lines Private Limited, could not be reached for comment.
